note: Three layers: (1) `by_category` is the curated HealthTasks-facing subset of slugs from context_iris.json. (2) `theory_mappings` lists values observed on behaviour_state/capability_opportunity entries (a subset of the canonical vocabularies). (3) `canonical_vocabularies` is the full upstream reference: BCIO subclass lists, BCTTv1 (93 techniques in 16 groupings), BCIO's own BCT subtree (BCIO_033000), and the canonical theory enumerations from Cane/Atkins (TDF v2 14 domains), Michie 2011 (COM-B 6), Schwarzer (HAPA 7), Prochaska & DiClemente (TTM 5 stages, 10 processes), Deci & Ryan (SDT 6 regulation levels, 3 needs), and Bergram 2022 (10 nudging patterns).

tdf_domain.version: TDF v2 (Cane, O'Connor & Michie 2012; Atkins 2017 Table 1)

comb_component.note: Each component has a deficit variant (suffix _low) used in calendar-bench theory_mappings to mark low capability/opportunity/motivation.

ttm_process.version: TTM processes of change (Prochaska & DiClemente 10 canonical processes)

sdt_regulation.note: calendar-bench theory_mappings also uses the coarse-grain marker 'autonomous_umbrella' for any of identified/integrated/intrinsic.

delivery_style.version: Bergram, Djurica, Sundar & Aleta 2022 digital-nudging taxonomy

bctt_v1.source: BCTT.xrdf (Michie et al. 2013, 93 BCTs in 16 hierarchical groupings)

Antecedents: Avoidance-reducing exposure to cues for the behavior

Monitoring of outcome(s) of behavior without feedback
Goals and planning: Discrepancy between current behavior and goal
Identity: Identification of self as role model
Natural consequences: Information about social and environmental consequences
Shaping knowledge: Instruction on how to perform the behavior
